description:
What an unbelievable catch this morning on Lake Belton! 💥 Check out this beautiful largemouth bass — the kind of fish that reminds you why we get up early, stay patient, and keep casting. 🎣💪

The fight on this one was unreal… every pull, every run, every splash had my heart pounding. ❤️ Moments like this make you feel alive — thankful for God’s creation, the peace of the water, and the rush that comes when hard work pays off. 🙏

I’m Eric Martinez, your Top Military Realtor in Central Texas, and I absolutely love spending time outdoors when I’m not helping families find their dream home. 🏡🇺🇸

Stay tuned  the full fight video will be posted later! You won’t want to miss it!

📍 Lake Belton, Texas
